label: casez and wildcard items
subgoals: Try the items in order and stop at the first match
Treat ? and z in a casez item as wildcards
Compare only the non-wildcard positions with the selector

label: Unknown bits in the selector
subgoals: Treat z in the selector as a wildcard under casez
Compare every bit literally under plain case
Read ? in plain case as a literal z

label: casex and x-masking
subgoals: Treat x and z in both item and selector as wildcards under casex
Recognize that an all-x selector matches the first item
Prefer casez or case inside to keep unknowns visible
